column1: # Chinese names of AI companies, products and people, and their usual English: scripts/fightin.py writes them in
# English in the Chinese texts before counting (LaBSE can't match names whose Chinese is unrelated to the English:
# 文心一言 vs "ERNIE Bot" scored 0.44). Write the English as English coverage does, capitalised (in Chinese texts,
# lowercase Latin words are dropped as quoted English). Longer names are replaced first (文心一言 before 文心).
# Also the official slogans (新质生产力, 中国式现代化 ...), in their standard English (Xinhua, State Council), so
# each is counted once rather than split across loose phrase matches. Every English word capitalised (Belt And
# Road: a lowercase word in a Chinese text breaks the phrase), and at least two words (phrases are 2-3 words).
